title: devx sdk todo 2026-03-04
content:
Quick notes / todo (personal scratchpad)

Context:
- Working on improving SDK quickstarts and docs for v0.8. Major pain points seen in support threads: streaming examples, function/tool-calling snippets, and minimal sample apps for web frameworks.
- Owners: me (Jamie) to draft, Alex to review streaming flow, Priya to vet tutorial language for PLG onboarding.

High-level to-do (priority order):
1) Quickstart streaming example: add minimal Node + fetch example and Python async example. Show both chunked streaming and SSE fallback.
   - Action: add code blocks to /docs/quickstart/streaming.md
   - Notes: show how to resume on network hiccups (simple retry + cursor). Mention token limits and recommended max_chunk_size.
   - TODO: ask infra for supported chunk sizes per model (Alex).

2) Function/tool calling examples: split into two short guides: 1) chat + tools (Node + Python) 2) structured output (JSON schema) with validation.
   - Problem: current examples use pseudo-code and confuse users about headers and content-type.
   - Action: replace with real runnable snippets, include curl, Node fetch, and python requests examples.
   - TODO: add test harness that runs examples in CI (GH Actions) to prevent rot.

3) Sample app: Next.js + Redwood API demo app (simple chat with streaming + fallback to non-stream).
   - MVP pages: /, /chat, /about with embedded sample prompt templates.
   - Integrations: show how to wire token-metering and server-side calls to Dedicated vs Hosted.
   - Action: scaffold repository under devx-examples/nextjs-chat. Aim for <= 200 LOC server side.

4) Tutorials: "Build a customer support bot" (target: product managers + engineers)
   - Need clearer evaluation section: guidance on prompts, eval sets, and rollback when model regression detected.
   - Action: reference Optimize -> evals workflow (link). Priya to write first draft text.

5) Docs cleanup: navigation and TOC reorg for SDK docs. Find orphan pages and add cross-links.
   - Action: run link-checker and collect 404s. Generate short report.

Bugs / doc gaps found (quick list):
- Streaming.md: missing Node fetch example and missing mention of SSE headers. (linked: GH #198)
- quickstart/index.md: sample env vars use REDWOOD_API_KEY but our SDK examples expect REDWOOD_KEY; standardize.
- function-calling.md: examples omit content-type: application/json for tool payloads.
- samples/auth.md: outdated oauth flow (mentions legacy redirect).

Small TODOs / reminders (one-liners):
- Add tests that run curl examples (small GH Action)
- Update snippet: show `client.stream` vs `client.generate` distinction
- Add note on cost: token estimation example for a 4k prompt + 512 response
- Add Windows PowerShell curl examples for common commands
- Create a demo prompt set for "support triage" (~20 prompts) for Optimize evals

Open questions / decisions:
- Should we include a full Next.js app in repo or keep it as a zip in docs? (pros: repo discoverability; cons: maintenance overhead)
- Standard env var name: REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY -> pick one and document migration (backwards compat note).
- Do we ship function-calling schema examples as JSON Schema or TypeScript types? (both?)

Timing / milestones (tentative):
- 2026-03-06: streaming quickstart draft ready (me + Alex review)
- 2026-03-10: function-calling runnable snippets + CI tests
- 2026-03-17: Next.js sample app initial commit (scaffold + README)
- 2026-03-24: Tutorials + Optimize eval set draft (Priya lead)

Links / references:
- Support threads: slack #devx-help (search: "streaming example")
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-sdk/pull/198 (streaming examples rewrite)
- Jira: DEVX-422 (streaming docs)

Notes to self (brain dump):
- Keep examples as copy-paste runnable as much as possible.
- Use small files and explicit import paths to reduce friction for new users.
- Consider a single "one-file" quickstart that works in both Node and Deno (or two separate one-file examples).
- When adding Next sample, capture cost estimate in README to set expectations.

Next-actions (today):
- Draft streaming.md edits (start with Node fetch example) -> 2h block
- Ping Alex about chunk size limits -> send quick DM
- Create repo scaffold for nextjs-chat with README and minimal server route -> create GH repo draft and invite Alex + Priya

-- end of scratchpad --
